reviews.review: A fantastic yet underrated game that is in dire need of appreciation. The main mechanic and overarching theme of time in this game encourages quick playthroughs, yet also adds an important decision for the player to make throughout his or her playthrough of the cost/benefit of taking more time on each level. Additionally, there are a plethora of characters and items that all add their own unique flavor to the run that you're currently playing. Although the game may fall flat in certain aspects, these are often limited to the current run. Overall, a solid game that I would recommend to anyone who enjoys highly replayable roguelikes.

Once you break through the first character wall this game becomes amazingly fun and hard. By that time you are able to know which items are good or bad and when to teleport, which are two key points in the game.
